description: Bornes de Recharge pour (IRVE) – schéma 2.2.0 sur le territoire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Saintes Grandes Rives, l'Agglo. Background In order to set up a national directory of charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (IRVE), open and accessible to all, local authorities carrying out an IRVE installation project must, as the stations are put into service, publish on the data.gouv.fr platform static data relating to the location and technical characteristics of those installations in ... Coverage: Saintes Grandes Rives, l'Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for electric vehicles (IRVE) – diagram 2.2.0 on the territory" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Saintes Grandes Rives, l'Agglo. Its keywords include caracteristiques-techniques, localisation, collectivites-territoriales, energie-electrique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PAGE WEB. The listing shows 2026-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
